0022600089.text: Both the Memphis Grizzlies and the Utah Jazz open their 2026-27 seasons, and this is the first game of the year for the Grizzlies, who host. Memphis is without Isaiah Stewart, who is out with an ankle injury, while Utah is missing Jusuf Nurkic (foot), Tony Bradley (quadriceps) and Trey Alexander (knee). The teams split their four 2025-26 meetings 2-2, and the most recent matchup was a 147-101 Utah win in Salt Lake City on April 10, 2026.
